SELECT theme_id AS themeId, theme_title AS themeTitle FROM p_theme ORDER BY theme_title
SELECT c.ctry_id AS ctryId, c.ctry_name AS ctryName, c.region_name AS regionName FROM location l JOIN country c ON c.ctry_id = l.ctry_id WHERE l.loc_id = #{locId}
SELECT hotel_id AS hotelId, hotel_name AS hotelName, hotel_code AS hotelCode, loc_id AS locId, hotel_tel AS hotelTel FROM hotels WHERE loc_id = #{value} ORDER BY hotel_name

WITH used AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(package_id, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1, 2)) AS n FROM packages WHERE package_id LIKE #{prefix} || '__' ), nums AS ( SELECT LEVEL AS n FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 99 ) SELECT LPAD(MIN(nums.n), 2, '0') AS next_no FROM nums LEFT JOIN used ON used.n = nums.n WHERE used.n IS NULL

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT i.item_id AS itemId, i.item_title AS itemTitle, i.loc_id AS locId, l.loc_name AS locName,
CASE WHEN #{keyword} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{keyword}) IS NULL THEN 9 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(i.item_title), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(l.loc_name), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(i.item_id), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 3 ELSE 9 END AS ord
FROM item i LEFT JOIN location l ON l.loc_id = i.loc_id
AND ( LOWER(i.item_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(i.item_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(l.loc_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY ord ASC, l.loc_name ASC, i.item_title ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT h.hotel_id AS "hotelId", h.hotel_name AS "hotelName", h.hotel_code AS "hotelCode", h.loc_id AS "locId", l.loc_name AS "locName",
CASE WHEN #{keyword} IS NULL OR TRIM(#{keyword}) IS NULL THEN 9 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(h.hotel_name), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(l.loc_name), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(h.hotel_code), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(h.hotel_id), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 4 ELSE 9 END AS ord FROM hotels h JOIN location l ON l.loc_id = h.loc_id
AND ( LOWER(h.hotel_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(h.hotel_code) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(h.hotel_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(l.loc_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY ord ASC, l.loc_name ASC, h.hotel_name ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
